HyAtlas dashboard - bundled webfont licenses
============================================

These woff2 files are shipped inside the HyAtlas binary (Go `//go:embed
dashboard/dist`) so the panel renders with its intended typography on an
isolated LAN with no route to fonts.googleapis.com / fonts.gstatic.com.

They are subsets (pyftsubset, GB2312 + latin, woff2 flavour) of fonts the user
already owns locally. Subsetting changes glyph coverage only: outlines,
copyright notices, license records and the fonts' internal names are preserved
verbatim (pyftsubset was run with --name-IDs='*').

Every file here is redistributable with this software:

  - Xiangcui Kesong  : SIL Open Font License 1.1
  - MiSans           : MiSans font license (Xiaomi) - free for personal and
                       commercial use, copyright notice must be retained
  - Maple Mono NF CN : SIL Open Font License 1.1 (Reserved Font Name "Maple Mono")

License text for OFL 1.1: https://openfontlicense.org/open-font-license-official-text/
SPDX identifier: OFL-1.1


1) Xiangcui Kesong  (香萃刻宋)
------------------------------
Files:     xiangcui-kesong.woff2
           (weight 400, style normal, subset: GB2312 + latin)
License:   SIL Open Font License 1.1
           (the distribution archive ships SIL_Open_Font_License_1.1.txt and
            states the font is free for personal and commercial use)
Copyright: as embedded in the source font (name table ID 13 carries the OFL
           notice; the upstream archive carries no separate copyright line)
Upstream:  https://www.maoken.com/  (猫啃网 distribution: 香萃刻宋 1.501)
           https://www.maoken.com/freefonts  (free-for-commercial-use index)
License:   OFL 1.1 text shipped with the font archive


2) MiSans
---------
Files:     misans-regular.woff2   (weight 400)
           misans-medium.woff2    (weight 500)
           (subset: GB2312 + latin)
License:   MiSans font license, Xiaomi (MiSans 字体知识产权许可协议) -
           released for free personal and commercial use; the copyright
           notice must be kept when the font is redistributed or embedded
Copyright: Copyright (c) 2020-2021 Beijing Xiaomi Mobile Software Co.,Ltd.
           All Rights Reserved.   (name table ID 0)
Upstream:  https://hyperos.mi.com/font/   (official MiSans release page)
           Font design: 汉仪字库 (https://www.hanyi.com.cn/, name table ID 11)
Note:      MiSans is NOT under the OFL. Its license permits bundling inside an
           application provided the font is not sold on its own and the
           copyright notice above travels with it - both conditions hold here.
           If this panel is ever redistributed outside the user's own NAS,
           re-check the license terms at the page above first.


3) Maple Mono NF CN
-------------------
Files:     maplemono-nf-cn-regular.woff2   (weight 400)
           maplemono-nf-cn-medium.woff2    (weight 500)
           (subset: GB2312 + latin, OpenType layout features kept via
            --layout-features='*', so calt/liga ligatures still work)
License:   SIL Open Font License 1.1, with Reserved Font Name "Maple Mono"
Copyright: Copyright (c) 2024, subframe7536 (https://github.com/subframe7536).
           (name table ID 0)
Upstream:  https://github.com/subframe7536/maple-font
           https://github.com/subframe7536/maple-font/blob/main/LICENSE.txt
Note:      The OFL reserved-name clause applies to modified versions being
           redistributed as a font product. Here the subset keeps the original
           internal names and is only bundled inside this application, so the
           Reserved Font Name is not being claimed for a new font.


Coverage and fallback
---------------------
Charset: ASCII (U+0020-U+007E) + Latin-1 supplement + General Punctuation
         (U+2000-U+206F) + CJK punctuation (U+3000-U+303F) + Fullwidth forms
         (U+FF00-U+FFEF) + every GB2312 character (6763 hanzi, generated
         programmatically from the codec, not hand-written ranges).
Rare characters outside GB2312 are intentionally not bundled: they fall back
per-character to the system CJK fonts named later in the CSS stacks in
../styles.css and ../starmap.css.
